payload.core_mechanism_summary: Simulate geometric progression terms while |b_i| ≤ l, skip bad integers via list membership, handle infinite cases (b1=0, q=0, q=1, q=-1).
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates all valid terms within the bound, pruning bad ones. This brute-force generation resembles a backtracking search without recursion, though it is a simple iterative loop.
